lines.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੇ ਪਰੇ ਸੁ ਲਏ ਬਚਾਇ ॥
lines.r: mahaa kaal kee saran je pare su le bachai ||
lines.ht: महा काल की सरनि जे परे सु लए बचाइ ॥

lines.g: ਔਰ ਨ ਉਪਜਾ ਦੂਸਰ ਜਗ ਭਛਿਯੋ ਸਭੈ ਬਨਾਇ ॥੩੬੬॥
lines.r: aauar na upajaa dhoosar jag bhachhiyo sabhai banai ||366||
lines.ht: और न उपजा दूसर जग भछियो सभै बनाइ ॥३६६॥

lines.g: ਜੋ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਸਿਕੇਤੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
lines.r: jo poojaa asiket kee nit prat karai banai ||
lines.ht: जो पूजा असिकेतु की नित प्रति करै बनाइ ॥

lines.g: ਤਿਨ ਪਰ ਅਪਨੋ ਹਾਥ ਦੈ ਅਸਿਧੁਜ ਲੇਤ ਬਚਾਇ ॥੩੬੭॥
lines.r: tin par apano haath dhai asidhuj let bachai ||367||
lines.ht: तिन पर अपनो हाथ दै असिधुज लेत बचाइ ॥३६७॥

lines.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਦੈਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: dhusaT dhait kachh baat na jaanee ||
lines.ht: दुसट दैत कछु बात न जानी ॥

lines.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਤਨ ਪੁਨਿ ਰਿਸਿ ਠਾਨੀ ॥
lines.r: mahaa kaal tan pun ris Thaanee ||
lines.ht: महा काल तन पुनि रिसि ठानी ॥

lines.g: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਫੂਲਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
lines.r: re re kaal fool jin jaahu ||
lines.ht: रे रे काल फूलि जिनि जाहु ॥

lines.g: ਏਕ ਪਾਵ ਤਜਿ ਜੁਧ ਨ ਭਾਜਾ ॥
lines.r: ek paav taj judh na bhaajaa ||
lines.ht: एक पाव तजि जुध न भाजा ॥

lines.g: ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲ ਪੁਨਿ ਜਿਯ ਮੈ ਕੋਪਾ ॥
lines.r: mahaa kaal pun jiy mai kopaa ||
lines.ht: महा काल पुनि जिय मै कोपा ॥

lines.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਬਿਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਰਥ ਚਕ੍ਰ ॥
lines.r: dhuhoo(n) bisikh kar dhavai rath chakr ||
lines.ht: दुहूँ बिसिख करि द्वै रथ चक्र ॥

lines.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਦਏ ਛਿਨ ਇਕ ਮੈ ਬਕ੍ਰ ॥
lines.r: kaaT dhe chhin ik mai bakr ||
lines.ht: काटि दए छिन इक मै बक्र ॥

lines.g: ਮਾਰ ਦਏ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੩੭੩॥
lines.r: maar dhe sabh jag ke raajaa ||373||
lines.ht: मार दए सभ जग के राजा ॥३७३॥

lines.g: ਦੁਤਿਯ ਬਾਨ ਸੌ ਦੋਊ ਅਰਿ ਕਰ ॥
lines.r: dhutiy baan sau dhouoo ar kar ||
lines.ht: दुतिय बान सौ दोऊ अरि कर ॥

lines.g: ੴ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹ ॥
lines.r: ikOankaar sree vaahiguroo jee kee fateh ||
lines.ht: ੴ स्री वाहिगुरू जी की फतह ॥
lines.e: There is one god, Waheguroo, Victory is his.
Written by the Sovereign King, Guru Gobind Singh Ji
Speech of the poet.
Chaupai
Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands
all the desires of my heart be fulfilled.
Let my mind rest under Thy Feet
Sustain me, considering me Thine own.377.
Destroy, O Lord! all my enemies and
protect me with Thine won Hands.
May my family live in comfort
and ease alongwith all my servants and disciples.378.

lines.g: ਮੋ ਰੱਛਾ ਨਿਜ ਕਰ ਦੈ ਕਰਿਯੈ ॥
lines.r: mo ra'chhaa nij kar dhai kariyai ||
lines.ht: मो रच्छा निज कर दै करियै ॥
lines.e: Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands
and destroy this day all my enemies
May all the aspirations be fulfilled
Let my thirst for Thy Name remain afresh.379.

lines.g: ਤੁਮਹਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੋਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਧਿਯਾਊਂ ॥
lines.r: tumeh chhaadd koiee avar na dhiyaauoo(n) ||
lines.ht: तुमहि छाडि कोई अवर न धियाऊं ॥
lines.e: I may remember none else except Thee

lines.g: ਜੋ ਬਰ ਚਹੋਂ ਸੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਊਂ ॥
lines.r: jo bar chaho(n) su tum te paauoo(n) ||
lines.ht: जो बर चहों सु तुम ते पाऊं ॥
lines.e: And obtain all the required boons from Thee
Let my servants and disciples cross the world-ocean
All my enemies be singled out and killed.380.
Protect me O Lord! with Thine own Hands and
relieve me form the fear of death
May Thou ever Bestow Thy favours on my side
Protect me O Lord! Thou, the Supreme Destroyer.381.
Protect me, O Protector Lord!
Most dear, the Protector of the Saints:
Friend of poor and the Destroyer of the enemies

lines.g: ਤੁਮ ਹੋ ਪੁਰੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਕੰਤਾ ॥੩੮੨॥
lines.r: tum ho puree chatur dhas ka(n)taa ||382||
lines.ht: तुम हो पुरी चतुर दस कंता ॥३८२॥
lines.e: Thou art the Master of the fourteen worlds.382.
In due time Brahma appeared in physical form
In due time Shiva incarnated
In due time Vishnu manifested himself
All this is the play of the Temporal Lord.383.
The Temporal Lord, who created Shiva, the Yogi
Who created Brahma, the Master of the Vedas
The Temporal Lord who fashioned the entire world
I salute the same Lord.384.
The Temporal Lord, who created the whole world
Who created gods, demons and yakshas
He is the only one form the beginning to the end
I consider Him only my Guru.385.
I salute Him, non else, but Him
Who has created Himself and His subject
He bestows Divine virtues and happiness on His servants

lines.g: ਸਤੱ੍ਰੁਨ ਕੋ ਪਲ ਮੋ ਬਧ ਕੀਓ ॥੩੮੬॥
lines.r: sata'run ko pal mo badh keeo ||386||
lines.ht: सत्््रुन को पल मो बध कीओ ॥३८६॥
lines.e: He destroys the enemies instantly.386.

lines.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਨਤ ॥
lines.r: ghaT ghaT ke a(n)tar kee jaanat ||
lines.ht: घट घट के अंतर की जानत ॥
lines.e: He knows the inner feelings of every heart
He knows the anguish of both good and bad
From the ant to the solid elephant

lines.g: ਸਭ ਪਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩੮੭॥
lines.r: sabh par kirapaa dhirasaT kar foolaa ||387||
lines.ht: सभ पर कृपा दृसटि कर फूला ॥३८७॥
lines.e: He casts His Graceful glance on all and feels pleased.387.
He is painful, when He sees His saints in grief
He is happy, when His saints are happy.
He knows the agony of everyone

lines.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਪਟ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਜਾਨੈਂ ॥੩੮੮॥
lines.r: ghaT ghaT ke paT paT kee jaanai(n) ||388||
lines.ht: घट घट के पट पट की जानैं ॥३८८॥
lines.e: He knows the innermost secrets of every heart.388.
When the Creator projected Himself,
His creation manifested itself in innumerable forms
When at any time He withdraws His creation,

lines.g: ਤੁਮ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਦੇਹ ਧਰ ਸਭਹੂੰ ॥੩੮੯॥
lines.r: tum mai milat dheh dhar sabhahoo(n) ||389||
lines.ht: तुम मै मिलत देह धर सभहूँ ॥३८९॥
lines.e: all the physical forms are merged in Him.389.
All the bodies of living beings created in the world
speak about Him according to their understanding
But Thou, O Lord! live quite apart from everything
this fact is know to the Vedas and the learned.390.
The Lord is Formless, Sinless and shelterless:
He is the Primal Power, without Blemish, without Beginning and Unborn
The fool claims boastfully about the knowledge of His secrets,

lines.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਭੇਵ ਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਬੇਦਾ ॥੩੯੧॥
lines.r: jaa ko bhev na paavat bedhaa ||391||
lines.ht: जा को भेव न पावत बेदा ॥३९१॥
lines.e: which even the Vedas do not know.391.
The fool considers Him a stone,

lines.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੂੜ੍ਹ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ॥
lines.r: mahaa mooRh kachh bhedh na jaanat ||
lines.ht: महा मूड़्ह कछु भेद न जानत ॥
lines.e: but the great fool does not know any secret
He calls Shiva “The Eternal Lord",
“but he does not know the secret of the Formless Lord.392.
According to ones won intellect,
one describes Thee differently
The limits of Thy creation cannot be known
and how the world was fashioned in the beginning?393.
He hath only one unparalleled Form
He manifests Himself as a poor man or a king at different places
He created creatures from eggs, wombs and perspiration
Then He created the vegetable kingdom.394.
Somewhere He sits joyfully as a king
Somewhere He contracts Himself as Shiva, the Yogi
All His creation unfolds wonderful things
He, the Primal Power, is from the beginning and Self-Existent.395.
O Lord! keep me now under Thy protection
Protect my disciples and destroy my enemies
All the villains creations outrage
and all the infidels be destroyed in the battlefield.396.
O Supreme Destroyer! those who sought Thy refuge,

lines.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਮਰੇ ॥
lines.r: tin ke dhushaT dhukhit havai mare ||
lines.ht: तिन के दुशट दुखित ह्वै मरे ॥
lines.e: their enemies met painful death
The persons who fell at Thy Feet,

lines.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਕਟ ਸਭ ਟਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੭॥
lines.r: tin ke tum sa(n)kaT sabh Taare ||397||
lines.ht: तिन के तुम संकट सभ टारे ॥३९७॥
lines.e: thou didst remove all their troubles.397.

lines.g: ਜੋ ਕਲਿ ਕੋ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਧਿਐ ਹੈ ॥
lines.r: jo kal ko ik baar dhiaai hai ||
lines.ht: जो कलि को इक बार धिऐ है ॥
lines.e: Those who meditate even on the Supreme Destroyer,

lines.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਾਲ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹਿ ਐਹੈ ॥
lines.r: taa ke kaal nikaT neh aaihai ||
lines.ht: ता के काल निकटि नहि ऐहै ॥
lines.e: death cannot approach them.
They remain protected at all times
Their enemies and troubles come to and end instantly.398.
Upon whomsoever Thou dost cast Thy favourable glance,
they are absolved of sins instantly

lines.g: ਰਿੱਧਿ ਸਿੱਧਿ ਘਰ ਮੋ ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.r: ri'dh si'dh ghar mo sabh hoiee ||
lines.ht: रिद्धि सिद्धि घर मो सभ होई ॥
lines.e: They have all the worldly and spiritual pleasures in their homes

lines.g: ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਛਾਹ ਛ੍ਵੈ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੯੯॥
lines.r: dhushaT chhaeh chhavai sakai na koiee ||399||
lines.ht: दुशट छाह छ्वै सकै न कोई ॥३९९॥
lines.e: None of their enemies can even touch their shadow.399.
He, who remembered Thee even once,
thou didst protect him from the noose of death
Those persons, who repeated Thy Name,
they were saved from poverty and attacks of enemies.400.
O Immortal Being (with the sword on Your banner)! I am under Your protection.
Give me Your hand and save me.
Stand by me everywhere,
and guard me against enmity and pain. 401.
The Mother of the world has been kind towards me
and I have completed the book this auspicious night
The Lord is the destroyer of all the sins of the body
and all the malicious and wicked persons.402.
When Mahakal became kind,
he immediately caused me to complete this book
He will obtain the fruit desired by the mind (who will read or listen to this book)
and no suffering will occur to him.403.
ARRIL

lines.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਗੁੰਗ ਜੋ ਯਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
lines.r: sunai gu(n)g jo yaeh su rasanaa paaviee ||
lines.ht: सुनै गुँग जो याहि सु रसना पावई ॥
lines.e: The dumb, who will listen to it, will be blessed with the tongue to speak

lines.g: ਸੁਨੈ ਮੂੜ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਇ ਚਤੁਰਤਾ ਆਵਈ ॥
lines.r: sunai mooR chit lai chaturataa aaviee ||
lines.ht: सुनै मूड़ चित लाइ चतुरता आवई ॥
lines.e: The fool, who will listen to it attentively, will get wisdom

lines.g: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਭੌ ਨਿਕਟ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਨਰ ਕੇ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.r: dhookh dharadh bhau nikaT na tin nar ke rahai ||
lines.ht: दूख दरद भौ निकट न तिन नर के रहै ॥
lines.e: That person will be absolved of suffering, pain or fear,

lines.g: ਹੋ ਜੋ ਯਾ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਬਾਰ ਚੌਪਈ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥੪੦੪॥
lines.r: ho jo yaa kee ek baar chauapiee ko kahai ||404||
lines.ht: हो जो या की एक बार चौपई को कहै ॥४०४॥
lines.e: Who will even once recite this Chaupai-prayer.404.
CHAUPAI
It was Bikrami Samvat 1753

lines.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਖ੍ਯਾਨੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰੇ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਭੂਪ ਸੰਬਾਦੇ ਚਾਰ ਸੌ ਪਾਂਚ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੪੦੫॥੭੫੫੮॥ ਅਫਜੰੂ ॥
lines.r: eit sree charitr pakhayaane tirayaa charitre ma(n)tree bhoop sa(n)baadhe chaar sau paa(n)ch charitr samaapatam sat subham sat ||405||7558|| afaja(n)oo ||
lines.ht: इति स्री चरित्र पख्याने तृया चरित्रे मंत्री भूप संबादे चार सौ पाँच चरित्र समापतम सतु सुभम सतु ॥४०५॥७५५८॥ अफजंू ॥
lines.e: This book was completed on the banks of Sutlej on Sunday, the eighth Sudi of the month of Bhadon.
SWAYYA

lines.g: ਪਾਇ ਗਹੇ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਆਂਖ ਤਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਆਨਯੋ ॥
lines.r: pai gahe jab te tumare tab te kouoo aa(n)kh tare nahee aanayo ||
lines.ht: पाइ गहे जब ते तुमरे तब ते कोऊ आँख तरे नही आनयो ॥
lines.e: O God! the day when I caught hold of your feet, I do not bring anyone else under my sight

lines.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਹੀਮ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਹੈਂ ਮਤ ਏਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਯੋ ॥
lines.r: raam raheem puraan kuraan anek kahai(n) mat ek na maanayo ||
lines.ht: राम रहीम पुरान कुरान अनेक कहैं मत एक न मानयो ॥
lines.e: None other is liked by me now   the Puranas and the Quran try to know Thee by the names of Ram and Rahim and talk about you through several stories,

lines.g: ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਸਭੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਦ ਕਹੈ ਹਮ ਏਕ ਨ ਜਾਨਯੋ ॥
lines.r: si(n)mirat saasatr bedh sabhai bahu bhedh kahai ham ek na jaanayo ||
lines.ht: सिंमृति सासत्र बेद सभै बहु भेद कहै हम एक न जानयो ॥
lines.e: The Simritis, Shastras and Vedas describe several mysteries of yours, but I do not agree with any of them.

lines.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸਿਪਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਕਹਯੋ ਸਭ ਤੋਹਿ ਬਖਾਨਯੋ ॥੮੬੩॥
lines.r: sree asipaan kirapaa tumaree kar mai na kahayo sabh toh bakhaanayo ||863||
lines.ht: स्री असिपान कृपा तुमरी करि मै न कहयो सभ तोहि बखानयो ॥८६३॥
lines.e: O sword-wielder God! This all has been described by Thy Grace, what power can I have to write all this?.863.
DOHRA

lines.g: ਸਗਲ ਦੁਆਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਗਹਯੋ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
lines.r: sagal dhuaar kau chhaadd kai gahayo tuhaaro dhuaar ||
lines.ht: सगल दुआर कउ छाडि कै गहयो तुहारो दुआर ॥
lines.e: O Lord! I have forsaken all other doors and have caught hold of only Thy door. O Lord! Thou has caught hold of my arm

lines.g: ਬਾਹਿ ਗਹੇ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਅਸਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾਸ ਤੁਹਾਰ ॥੮੬੪॥
lines.r: baeh gahe kee laaj as gobi(n)dh dhaas tuhaar ||864||
lines.ht: बाहि गहे की लाज असि गोबिंद दास तुहार ॥८६४॥
lines.e: I, Govind, am Thy serf, kindly take (care of me and) protect my honour.864.
